parsed.difference_why: The SSM form strictly requires the transition matrix to depend only on the input x_t, but here the pop operation multiplies by W_{top(M_{t-1})}^{-1}, a matrix selected based on the state's own column sums, fundamentally altering the recurrence to be piecewise and state-dependent rather than input-driven.

parsed.family_why: The push operation matches the SSM form h_t = A(x_t) h_{t-1} as a right multiplication by an input-chosen matrix W_j, but the pop operation depends on decoding the top of the stack from M_{t-1}, making it state-dependent.
